utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Good morning to everyone. Before we revert to closed session, may we have the appearances, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Your Honour, Joanna Korner assisted by Crispian Smith, Case Manager for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Slobodan Zecevic, Slobodan Cvijetic, Eugene O'Sullivan, and Tatjana Savic, appearing for Stanisic Defence. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For Zupljanin Defence this morning, Igor Pantelic, Dragan Krgovic, and Miroslav Cuskic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. Before we resume, we have a ruling on that matter yesterday. I'm not sure -- although we were in closed session when the application was made, I'm not sure whether need be in closed session.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: No, I don't think it -- the application was made in closed, but the ruling can certainly be made in open.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: By the majority the Chamber has agreed to admit the document. The dissent being on the basis that insufficient reason has been given for the Chamber to deviate from the guide-lines that it has set down.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Will become Exhibit P1285, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated] ... so we revert to closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 14th of April, 2010, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.47 p.m.,
